# Lab 25.14: Mute Rules & Pub/Sub Notifications

## What We Are Going to Do
Mute expected findings from a sandbox project, and send new high-severity findings to Pub/Sub for alerts.

## Steps

1. **Create a mute rule for a sandbox project.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud scc muteconfigs create mute-sandbox-firewall \
  --organization=ORG_ID --location=global \
  --description="Open firewall is expected in the sandbox" \
  --filter='category="OPEN_FIREWALL" AND resource.project_display_name="sandbox-project"' \
  --type=DYNAMIC</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   A dynamic rule mutes matching findings only while they match. Add `--expiry-time` to end it automatically.

2. **Check muted findings.** In **Findings**, the quick filter **Mute state** shows **Muted** findings separately. They are hidden by default, not deleted.

3. **Create a topic for alerts.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud pubsub topics create scc-high
gcloud pubsub subscriptions create scc-high-sub --topic=scc-high</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **Create the notification config.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud scc notifications create scc-high-notify \
  --organization=ORG_ID --location=global \
  --pubsub-topic=projects/$PROJECT_ID/topics/scc-high \
  --filter='state="ACTIVE" AND (severity="HIGH" OR severity="CRITICAL") AND mute!="MUTED"'</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


5. **Trigger a finding.** Repeat step 1 of Lab 25.13 in a non-sandbox project.

6. **Read the notification.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud pubsub subscriptions pull scc-high-sub --auto-ack --limit=1 \
  --format="value(message.data)" | head -c 800</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   The message holds the full finding in JSON. A Cloud Run function can read it and alert a chat channel or fix the problem.

7. **Clean up.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud scc notifications delete scc-high-notify --organization=ORG_ID --location=global --quiet
gcloud scc muteconfigs delete mute-sandbox-firewall --organization=ORG_ID --location=global --quiet
gcloud pubsub subscriptions delete scc-high-sub
gcloud pubsub topics delete scc-high</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Sandbox findings | Muted, still stored |
| High findings | Pushed to Pub/Sub in near real time |
| Filter | Same syntax as the Findings page |
| Next step | Automate alerts or fixes from Pub/Sub |
